scenarios.name: reviewed_competing_attempt_uses_explicit_activity_decision
prove: proposal generation requires an ACTIVE existing WFM Task already in a reviewed activity lineage, a complete candidate source interval, and LLD-05 SAME_REVIEWED_LINEAGE_OVERLAP
each proposal binds one exact deterministic conflicting counterpart through its immutable ordinal-0 conflict change and binds the complete conflict authority through base_state_token_sha256
generic AcceptReconciliationProposal returns IMPORT_PROPOSAL_BLOCKED for this kind
the dedicated command requires source identity/projection acceptance first, then exact current conflict fingerprint plus exact LLD-05 activity-review fingerprint for the explicit decision
same_activity, retry_lineage, distinct_activity and unresolved_source_error remain operator decisions; overlap never chooses one

participant APPLIED commits LLD-05 lineage history and accepted LLD-04 disposition in one outer UoW; participant semantic NO_CHANGE creates no duplicate lineage history but may accept the exact review proposal
no Task/TK identity, provider source projection, operational plan or Objective membership is merged or rewritten by the review

scenarios.name: competing_attempt_conflict_drift_rolls_back_before_receipt
prove: source projection, local execution/outcome, lineage, plan interval or selected counterpart authority changing the exact conflict set changes or removes the conflict fingerprint
dedicated resolution returns IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE before receipt/participant mutation
proposal stays pending and immutable; refreshed reconciliation may supersede it

scenarios.name: competing_attempt_participant_failure_is_atomic
prove: explicit seed Task revision drift returns TASK_STALE or fingerprint drift returns TASK_ACTIVITY_REVIEW_STALE before mutation
injected LLD-05 participant write or audit failure rolls back the one outer receipt, every lineage/event/Task revision mutation, LLD-04 disposition/run counters and all audits/results
exact replay after success returns the immutable original ProposalDecisionResultV1 before current conflict/Task reads
